// 01 — About

Data that drives real decisions.

🎓 Industrial Civil Engineer · UDP

I am Francisco Santelices, Industrial Civil Engineer with over 7 years of experience in high-complexity operational environments, managing analytics for 600+ locations nationwide.

I specialize in transforming scattered data into clear models that enable leadership to make evidence-based decisions: inventory control, fraud detection, executive dashboards and commercial incentive models.

I integrate Artificial Intelligence across the entire analytical workflow — boosting speed, precision and accessibility of insights for both technical and non-technical teams.
